content_sections.heading: CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: CSIR Institute of Minerals and Materials Technology (CSIR IMMT), Bhubaneswar has officially released the Recruitment Notification 2026 for 38 vacancies across various project posts. The recruitment includes Project Associate I, Project Associate II, Senior Project Associate, Junior Research Fellow, and Project Assistant II posts. The notification contains complete details regarding post-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, age limit, salary, eligibility conditions, walk-in interview schedule, and application procedure. Candidates are advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying. Download CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Online Application Link Official Website

content_sections.heading: CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026 varies by post, as on the last date of receipt of application (15.09.2026): 28 years - Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts (8624, 8625). 35 years - Project Associate I, Project Associate II and Project Assistant II posts (most post codes; see the vacancy table for the exact post code). 40 years - Senior Project Associate posts (8603, 8621, 8623, 8628, 8632). 50 years - Post code 8635 (Project Associate I, M.Sc. in Microbiology/ Biotechnology). Age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ ST/ PwBD/ Women candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates, or as per Government of India instructions issued from time to time. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any written examination. Based on the information provided, the CSIR IMMT selection process consists of: Screening and shortlisting of online applications as per criteria fixed by the Competent Authority. A walk-in interview for shortlisted candidates at CSIR - IMMT, Bhubaneswar. No separate interview call letter will be issued, and no TA/ DA is admissible for appearing at the interview. Selected candidates must join duty immediately on receipt of the offer of engagement. The tentative walk-in interview schedule, grouped by post code and subject/ branch, is given below. These dates are tentative; any change will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through the CSIR IMMT website, which applicants are advised to check regularly.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026 Apply Online process involves two steps on the CSIR IMMT recruitment portal: Complete a one-time registration on the online portal. Fill in and submit the online application for the specific post code. Take a printout of the application form after successful submission. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate online application for each post code. Shortlisted candidates must report for the walk-in interview at CSIR - IMMT, Bhubaneswar, carrying the following documents in original: Printout of the online application form. Any ID proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID Card / PAN Card / Passport / Driving License). Mark sheets and certificates of all years/ semesters from 10th/ Matriculation onwards, including CGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate where applicable. Category/ EWS certificate, if applicable. No Objection Certificate (NOC), if applicable. Experience certificate, if applicable. For queries related to the CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026 notification, candidates can write to [email protected] on or before 14.09.2026 (up to 4:00 pm). The application fee for CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026 is not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by CSIR – Institute of Minerals and Materials Technology, Bhubaneswar (Advertisement No. PME/P86/2026, dated 01.09.2026) to fill 38 temporary project positions such as Project Associate‑I, Project Associate‑II, Senior Project Associate, Project Assistant‑II and Junior Research Fellow across 37 post codes.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 38 vacancies in total across 37 post codes (8601 to 8637); post code 8627 has 2 vacancies and all other post codes have 1 vacancy each.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the online application is 15.09.2026, up to 5:00 pm.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements range from a Diploma or B.Sc. to B.E./B.Tech., M.Sc., M.E./M.Tech. or Ph.D., depending on the specific post code. See the vacancy table above for the exact essential qualification for each post code.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years for JRF posts, 35 years for most Project Associate/Project Assistant posts, 40 years for Senior Project Associate posts, and 50 years for post code 8635, as on the last date of application. Age relaxation of 5 years (SC/ST/PwBD/Women) and 3 years (OBC) applies as per Government of India instructions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must complete a one-time registration and then fill the online application on the CSIR IMMT recruitment portal (rects.immt.res.in), then take a printout of the submitted form. A separate application is required for each post code.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSIR IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves screening/shortlisting of applications followed by a walk-in interview at CSIR – IMMT, Bhubaneswar. No written exam is mentioned in the notification.
